name: distributed-rate-limiter
description: A system design case study exploring distributed rate limiting.
author: Thiago Dias

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node --test ".test-dist/tests/unit/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:compile: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:demo: npm run test:integration && npm run test:demo
